_about: Hand-picked points on the corridor's plan of the loop (KENDRIYA SADANA.pdf, one sheet, a scanned-style image with no vector data). Pixel positions are on the page rendered at 110 dpi (5149 x 3643 px), x right, y down. Control points are things whose map position is known: the two foot over bridges (OpenStreetMap) and the centre of the Level-1 rotary (traced from the tender drawings).

control.what: centre of the rotary at Madiwala junction
foot over bridge across Sarjapura Road, midpoint (OSM way 779344661)
foot over bridge at junction C, north end (OSM way 779344666)
foot over bridge at junction C, corner
foot over bridge at junction C, south-west end

shapes.what: Tunnel approach connecting the road tunnel to the Audgodi loop (beside Hosur Road at the college playground)
shapes.basis: Schedule B of the tender lists a "Tunnel approach connecting to Audgodi loop", 170 m long and 7 m wide. On the loop plan this strip runs along the north-west side of the Hosur Road deck from the "End of Main Tunnel Tube 1" arrow (chainage 16+745), with pillars labelled HTA1 to HTA3 beside it. The outline is the thin orange line on the plan and is narrower than 7 m

shapes.what: Pedestrian subway under Sarjapura Road at the metro station (marked SUBWAY on the plan)
shapes.basis: two pairs of bars across Sarjapura Road labelled SUBWAY, between the BMRCL block on the hospital side and the station

_note_exit_ramp: Exit Ramp 01 was first picked by hand here; it now comes from the concept drawing (step concept), which is vector and shows the whole ramp.
